description: (Na)₂RbCoF₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a RbCoF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the RbCoF₆ framework, Rb is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form RbF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CoF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Rb-F bond lengths are 2.56 Å. Co is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form CoF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent RbF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Co-F bond lengths are 1.86 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Rb and one Co atom.
